invariants.rationale: Collectors.toList() never returns null, so the returned list should be non-null.
Each element is retrieved as fg.getFileId(); it is expected that file IDs are non-null strings.
The method uses .distinct(), ensuring all file IDs in the result are unique.
File IDs are unlikely to be empty strings.
As each getFileId() should be non-null, the result should contain no null entries.
